lines.text: Every coding agent keeps its own memory. Switch tools, and you start over.
One thread over every agent. Pass the baton, and the context goes with it — decisions, memory, the whole conversation.
Five agents, working today. Or let Loom route the whole job — plan, execute, review.
Same thread on your desk, and in your pocket.
